Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Carousel: Redesign the pet choice screen into a full-bleed visual carousel with interactive preview cards and preset pet trait tags. (why: Adoption step has the highest funnel drop-off (60.9% conversion) and a median duration of 89s, showing strong selection friction.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Adopt Before Account Sign-In Flow: Reorder onboarding so users choose and customize their pet before signing in to build emotional attachment first. (why: Asking for sign-in upfront before users pick a pet causes unnecessary drop-off (80% sign-in pass rate) before user commitment.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Generation Waiting Stage: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout with a real-time progress timer, sound effects, and pet trivia tips. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) with an 81.3% conversion rate, causing user abandonment while loading.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Path Selector Visual Grid Layout: Convert the path selection screen into a split visual comparison grid detailing preset vs custom pet creation times. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between custom photo and preset routes.)
